description: ALBANY—State Senator George Borrello has been ranked one of the most effective Republican legislators in the New York State Senate, according to the latest Legislative Effectiveness Scores released by the Center for Effective Lawmaking. The analysis placed Senator Borrello first among Senate Republicans for the 246th Legislative Session, based on a detailed review of sponsored bills, committee actions, and measures signed into law.Senator Borrello said the rating is the result of his commitment
